rules.statement: A bona fide purchaser for value without notice of a trust can be deprived of the property purchased on the ground of any irregularities in the order for sale, or in the procedure by which that order was obtained only if the Court ordering the sale has jurisdiction.
rules.supporting_quote: The defendant is, in my opinion, entitled to shelter himself under the authority of the order of the District Court of Badulla if he can show-for as to this the burden of proof is on him-that he made the purchase in good faith for valuable consideration and without notice of the trust.
